name: Hackathon credits a pair-to-pair transfer twice
summary: Hackathon's _transfer ran both its buy and sell branches when sender and recipient were the same registered pair, crediting the amount twice, so the attacker skimmed the Hackathon/USDT pair to itself to inflate its balance and swapped the surplus out for the pair's USDT, 49 minutes after the pair was registered.
notes: The reset is prepare() registering the pair, on which both branches depend; the later prepare() only zeroed the transfer fee.
Loss is the pair's USDT; its Hackathon is valued at nothing (rule 12).
